# Phase Docs

> Phase is an open source & end-to-end encrypted platform for creating, managing, syncing and deploying secrets and environment variables across your infrastructure.

Each link points to the Markdown version of a page. Remove `.md` from the URL for the HTML page.

## Get Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.phase.dev/index.md): Phase is an open source & end-to-end encrypted platform for creating, managing, syncing and deploying secrets and environment variables across your infrastructure.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.phase.dev/quickstart.md): This guide will get you all set up and ready to use the Phase console.

## Console

- [Overview](https://docs.phase.dev/console.md): This guide will explain how the Phase Console works.
- [Organisations](https://docs.phase.dev/console/organisation.md): This guide will explain how organisations work in Phase
- [Users](https://docs.phase.dev/console/users.md): This guide will explain how user accounts work in Phase
- [Apps](https://docs.phase.dev/console/apps.md): This guide explains how Apps work in Phase.
- [Environments](https://docs.phase.dev/console/environments.md)
- [Secrets](https://docs.phase.dev/console/secrets.md): This guide will explain how to work with Secrets in Phase
- [Dynamic Secrets](https://docs.phase.dev/console/dynamic-secrets.md): This guide will explain how to work with Dynamic Secrets in Phase
- [Rotating Secrets](https://docs.phase.dev/console/rotating-secrets.md): This guide will explain how to work with Rotating Secrets in Phase.
- [Log Streams](https://docs.phase.dev/console/logstreams.md): Stream organisation audit logs and secret events from Phase to your SIEM or log management platform in near real-time.

## CLI

- [Overview](https://docs.phase.dev/cli.md): This guide will explain how the Phase CLI works.
- [Install](https://docs.phase.dev/cli/install.md): Manage your secrets and environment variables with the Phase CLI
- [Quickstart](https://docs.phase.dev/cli/usage.md): Manage your secrets and environment variables with the Phase CLI
- [Commands](https://docs.phase.dev/cli/commands.md): Manage your secrets and environment variables with the Phase CLI

## SDKs

- [Overview](https://docs.phase.dev/sdks.md): Phase SDKs allow you to securely manage secrets within your applications, providing a seamless integration with the Phase platform.
- [Python](https://docs.phase.dev/sdks/python.md): SDK to integrate Phase secret management in Python applications.
- [Golang](https://docs.phase.dev/sdks/go.md): SDK to integrate Phase in server-side applications running Go.
- [Node.js](https://docs.phase.dev/sdks/node.md): SDK to integrate Phase in applications running Node.js.

## API

- [Overview](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api.md): This guide will explain how to work with the Phase REST API.
- [Apps](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api/apps.md): Explore the Phase Apps API for managing applications programmatically.
- [Environments](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api/environments.md): Explore the Phase Environments API for managing environments programmatically.
- [Secrets](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api/secrets.md): Explore the Phase Secrets API.
- [Dynamic Secrets](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api/dynamic-secrets.md): Explore the Phase Secrets API.
- [Members](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api/members.md): Explore the Phase Members API for managing organisation members and their access programmatically.
- [Invites](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api/invites.md): Explore the Phase Invites API for creating, listing, and cancelling pending organisation member invitations.
- [Service Accounts](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api/service-accounts.md): Explore the Phase Service Accounts API for managing service accounts programmatically.
- [Teams](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api/teams.md): Explore the Phase Teams API for managing teams, team membership, and team-scoped app access programmatically.
- [Roles](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api/roles.md): Explore the Phase Roles API for managing roles and permissions programmatically.
- [External Identities](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api/external-identities.md): Authenticate with Phase using external identity providers (AWS IAM, Azure).
- [Errors](https://docs.phase.dev/public-api/errors.md): In this guide, we will talk about what happens when something goes wrong while you work with the API.

## Authentication & Access

- [Overview](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control.md): This guide explains how to authenticate with Phase and manage access with the Access Control system.
- [Authentication](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/authentication.md): Authenticating with Phase.
- [Single Sign-On (SSO)](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/authentication/sso.md): Configure single sign-on for your organisation from the Phase Console.
- [OAuth 2.0](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/authentication/oauth-sso.md): Authenticating via various OAuth Single sign-on providers with Phase.
- [OpenID Connect (OIDC)](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/authentication/oidc-sso.md): Authenticating via various OIDC Single sign-on providers with Phase.
- [Two-Factor Authentication](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/authentication/mfa.md): Protect your Phase account with TOTP-based two-factor authentication.
- [Account Management](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/authentication/account.md): Manage your Phase account: linked sign-in methods, email address, display name, and account deletion.
- [Tokens](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/authentication/tokens.md): Learn how to create and manage authentication tokens in Phase.
- [SCIM Provisioning](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/provisioning/scim.md): Set up SCIM v2 provisioning to automatically sync users and groups from your identity provider to Phase.
- [Teams](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/teams.md): Organize members and service accounts into Teams with scoped app access and optional role overrides.
- [Service Accounts](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/service-accounts.md)
- [External Identities](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/external-identities.md): This guide explains how to use External Identities to authenticate with Phase and manage access with the Access Control system.
- [Roles](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/roles.md)
- [Network](https://docs.phase.dev/access-control/network.md)

## Security

- [Overview](https://docs.phase.dev/security.md): Phase architecture, threat model, and security implementation.
- [Architecture](https://docs.phase.dev/security/architecture.md): Learn about the cryptographic architecture used to generate encryption keys, secure keys for storage / transmission over the network and perform encryption or decryption operations.
- [Cryptographic Algorithms](https://docs.phase.dev/security/cryptography.md): Cryptographic algorithms used in Phase Encryption

- [GitLab CI](https://docs.phase.dev/integrations/platforms/gitlab-ci.md): Integrate Phase with GitLab CI

## Self-Host

- [Overview](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting.md): Run Phase on your own infrastructure
- [Docker Compose](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/docker-compose.md): Run Phase on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose.
- [Docker Compose + Tailscale](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/tailscale.md): Run a private Phase Console on your Tailscale network (tailnet) with Docker Compose.
- [Kubernetes](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/kubernetes.md): Deploy Phase via the official Helm chart on your Kubernetes cluster.
- [AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/aws-eks.md): Deploy Phase via Helm on your AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) cluster.
- [Azure Kubernetes Service](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/azure-aks.md): Deploy Phase via Helm on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), with standard or Tailscale networking.
- [AWS EC2 & RDS](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/aws.md): Run Phase on your own Amazon Web Services infrastructure.
- [Google Cloud Platform](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/gcp.md): Run Phase on your own Google Cloud Platform infrastructure.
- [Azure](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/azure.md): Run Phase on your own Microsoft Azure infrastructure.
- [Railway](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/railway.md): Deploy the Phase Console Railway template.
- [DigitalOcean](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/digitalocean.md): Run Phase on your own DigitalOcean infrastructure.
- [RaspberryPi](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/raspberrypi.md): Run Phase on your Raspberry Pi with docker-compose.
- [Deployment configuration](https://docs.phase.dev/self-hosting/configuration/envars.md): Overview of Phase Console deployment configuration options
